label: Adaptive transcript equality by preserved transition matching (inference)
rule: Induction on the finite experiment length using equal transcripts to select the same next action
meaning: A universally quantified conditional mathematical result. Matching initial states gives equal initial readouts. At each induction step the shared policy receives the same earlier transcript and selects the same action; successor preservation supplies related next states and thus equal new readouts. The proof constrains a recursively defined experiment, rather than applying a premise already containing the transcript conclusion. The state/repertoire correspondence to admissible real histories remains OPEN. Named research connection: historical reliability as a rival test for local existential PSR 608a262d, with no registered implication from bruteness to this matching premise or from indistinguishability to skeptical defeat.
